title: Week of November 25, 2026
intro: Eight auctions worth watching this week, picked from every live Bring a Trailer listing that matches a truck we cover. Bids are as of Wednesday morning. Each card links to our checklist for that truck, so read it before you bid.

picks.title: 2004 Toyota 4Runner SR5 V8
picks.context: 4th Gen 4Runners sold for $12,250–28,500 last month, with all 5 selling (median $18,500).

picks.title: 1984 Toyota Land Cruiser FJ60, 4-speed
picks.context: 60 Series median: $32,000 over the past month, with 12 of 13 sold.

picks.title: 1996 Lexus LX450
picks.context: All 17 LX 450s and 470s sold last month, at a $26,500 median. A 28k-mile LX 450 made $82,000.

picks.title: 1996 Land Rover Defender 130 300Tdi Hi-Cap, 5-speed
picks.context: No reserve. Classic Defenders sold at a $43,250 median last month, but only 16 of 33 met reserve.

picks.title: 2005 Mercedes-Benz G55 AMG
picks.context: No reserve. Early W463 G 500s sold for $20,250–32,100 last month.

picks.title: 47k-mile 2010 Toyota FJ Cruiser Trail Teams Special Edition, 6-speed
picks.context: FJ Cruiser median: $23,000. A 16k-mile 2014 Trail Teams Ultimate made $68,888.

picks.title: 1993 Toyota Land Cruiser FZJ70
picks.context: No reserve. 70 Series median: $16,900 (6 sold last month).

picks.title: 21k-mile 2005 Jeep Wrangler Rubicon 4.0
picks.context: Wrangler TJ median: $13,500 across 15 sales. The best one made $38,500.
